$comment: PRE-7 ORTAM-HAZIR (2026-10-20): the coding probe kinds of this adapter. A declared requirement {kind, target, expect?} runs the kind's argv in a container on the worker's floor (no network, no connection, no model); a whole-element placeholder {target}/{expect} is replaced by the declared value, never interpolated into a shell. Exit 0 = met. executable: the command answers --version. path-readable: a path (for example the dependency mount /node_modules/typescript) is readable. node-heap: the Node heap ceiling in the container (set by docker-supervisor/internal/node-heap.json from the memory limit, PRE-2) is at least {expect} bytes. timeoutMs bounds one probe container.
$comment_templateDefaults: PRE-7 phase 2 (lead Q3): the requirements `coding template` / `init registry` declare on a coding template that declares none. requirements: always; whenMounted: only when the template binds a read-only dependency mount at that target; nodeHeap: expect = the heap ceiling node-heap.json sets for the template's memory (omitted when it sets none).
